summary.intent: Run the GSD plan-phase workflow for Phase 45 (Desktop FUSE write-durability cleanup) and then auto-advance into execute-phase, executing all 6 plans across 5 waves on a Rust-only hygiene refactor of the FUSE write-journal/replay code.
summary.outcome: Planning completed successfully: research, pattern mapping, validation, and 6 plans in 5 waves were generated, verified (0 blockers), and committed. Execution began and Wave 1 Plan 45-01 (characterization test safety net) completed; Wave 1 Plan 45-02 was spawned but the transcript ends before its result arrives.

repo: The FUSE crate is `cipherbox-fuse` with default feature `fuse`; cargo commands should target `-p cipherbox-fuse --features fuse`.
The intel API surface extractor only covers non-Rust languages — it returned 0 symbols for this phase, so the planner received no API surface intel.
`fuse_abi.rs` carries pre-existing dead-code warnings from the vendored fuser ABI file; these are unrelated to phase changes and should be ignored in CI noise analysis.
`.planning/config.json` has `auto_advance: true`, which causes plan-phase to chain straight into execute-phase unless explicitly paused.

Waves 2–5 of Phase 45 all serialize through `crates/fuse/src/lib.rs`, making parallel worktree execution unsafe despite `USE_WORKTREES=true` being set; sequential execution on the feature branch was the correct fallback.

The GSD commit helper can return a false-negative `commit_failed` status when lint-staged output is present — the commit actually lands; always verify with `git log` before acting on the failure signal.
The GSD system has a pattern-mapper gate that finds code analogs before planning; it found 3 analogs relevant to `journal_helpers.rs` and the new error variant.

Phase 45 scope: 7 items — shared journal-dir helper, `Option<String>` sentinel for `file_meta_ipns_name`, typed `IpnsResolveOutcome`, reuse `publish_file_metadata` in replay, memoize `resolve_folder_key`, consolidate fuser/winfsp journal builders, and a test safety net.

code.finding: Template placeholders in Test Infrastructure and Sampling sections were left unfilled by the VALIDATION template generator; had to be manually replaced with real `cargo test -p cipherbox-fuse` commands after discovering the crate name.
Open Questions section lacked a `(RESOLVED)` marker after research completed; this triggered a non-blocking verification warning and required a manual doc edit.

workflow: The GSD verification loop reported 2 non-blocking warnings (VALIDATION.md placeholders, RESEARCH.md open-questions marker) that are worth fixing immediately to keep artifacts clean rather than deferring.
When worktrees are enabled but all plans in waves 2+ share a file (`lib.rs`), the correct choice is sequential execution on the feature branch — worktree merge risk outweighs parallelism benefit.

The `gsd-executor` subagent pattern commits atomically per plan and updates STATE/ROADMAP itself, so the orchestrator only needs to spot-check completion (SUMMARY presence + branch) rather than managing commits.
The plan-phase workflow emits a `research-only mode` (`--research-phase N`) for cheaper correction loops — useful when iterating on research alone without re-spawning the full planner.
